caption: Error of seed 1234 of the shipped surrogate (surrogate/) (colour) and of the phase-only baseline (grey) on the same holdout rows, divided by that grid's baseline RMSE (RMSE₀), as a density on a log axis; skill = 1 − (RMSE / RMSE₀)². Note that each grid is scored against its own corpus's phase-only baseline; widths are not compared across the two rows (one seed; each panel gives its 5-seed skill range). Rows are consecutive timesteps of 6 configurations, not independent samples. Targets are lab-frame components of the IB force and moment on the wing; moments about the hinge. Holdout rows are the second wingbeat of 2-beat runs; the corpus is to be regenerated with longer runs.
